Container.Name: WARHOST
Container.Overview:
WARHOST runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server and writes login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json from this form.
WARNO was a game made in France, but WARHOST was created in the United States.
Request a login and key from eugsupport@eugensystems.com (one pair runs five servers); the preset is the base-game map Hesse 2v2 with no workshop mods, the Map and Workshop Mod List descriptions show the Red Dragon map pack values, map and mod IDs are in the project README, and each server's game port must be forwarded to this Unraid server as TCP and UDP. The next container uses that port plus 1, and its settings folder uses that new port, for example /mnt/user/appdata/warno/10401/settings. The image is built FROM eugensystems/warno:latest and its license is left unlabeled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: WARNO WARNO server dedicated server game server mods modded
Container.Requires: An Eugen Systems WARNO dedicated-server login and key for the person hosting. Joining players need the game, plus each Steam Workshop mod in Workshop Mod List, for example item 3811913066 for the Red Dragon map pack. With a Workshop id in that list, the server also reaches Steam at each start to read the mod's Version.

Config.Name: Settings Folder
Config.Description: Ini files for this container only. Use /mnt/user/appdata/warno/10400/settings. The next container uses this path with the port number plus 1, for example /mnt/user/appdata/warno/10401/settings.

Config.Name: Eugen Login
Config.Description: Login from Eugen's reply, exactly as written. Not your Steam name; this login and the key are a matching pair good for five containers.

Config.Name: Eugen Dedicated Key
Config.Description: Key from the same reply. Shown in clear text on this form so servers can be told apart.

Config.Name: Public WAN IP
Config.Description: Public address players connect to. Not a hostname, and not this Unraid server's LAN address.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Forward this number to the Unraid host as TCP and UDP. The next container uses this number plus 1. Players join by Server Name in the browser.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name in the WARNO browser. Give each container a different name. No equals sign.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: Scenario ID, not the display name. Preset _2x2_Hesse_2vs2_CONQ, a base-game map. Red Dragon example: RDPort_JungleLaw_2v2_CONQ with Workshop Mod List 3811913066. Full lists are in the project README.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Total slots, both sides. Preset 4, maximum 20, not locked to the map; 8 on a 2v2 map is untested.

Config.Name: Minimum Players
Config.Description: Players needed before the countdown starts. Cannot be higher than Max Players.

Config.Name: Team Size
Config.Description: Slots on one side. Preset 2, usually half of Max Players.

Config.Name: Combat Rule
Config.Description: 1 is Destruction and 2 is Conquest. Use 2 when the scenario ID contains CONQ or Conquest, and 1 when it contains DEST or Destruction.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod List
Config.Description: Empty for a base-game map. Red Dragon map pack example: 3811913066. Each start reads that mod's current Version from Steam; id/version pins a number. Join mods with a hyphen. none also means empty. Named mods are in the project README.

Config.Name: Write Config From Form
Config.Description: true rewrites the settings files from this form on every start. With Lobby Page true, an existing variables.ini stays. false leaves the files and sets login.ini to mode 600.

Config.Name: Lobby Page
Config.Description: false starts no lobby page. true serves it at the game port plus 1000, so 10400 uses 11400. Do not forward that port. Saving writes variables.ini; restart the container to load it.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod Tags
Config.Description: Empty for a base-game map. Map pack example: Maps-Scenarios. Browser icons only; words are Gameplay, Interface, Maps, Scenarios, Music, and Sound, joined with hyphens. none also means empty.
